chars.FATHER: FATHER: a middle-aged man wearing a long brown wool djellaba with a pointed hood down and yellow leather babouche slippers
chars.BROTHER: BROTHER: a young man wearing a bright green bomber jacket, a white t-shirt and blue jeans with white sneakers
chars.DET: DET: a police detective wearing a long beige trench coat over a dark grey suit with a red tie
chars.DOC: DOC: a female lab doctor wearing a white lab coat, a teal scrub cap and blue latex gloves

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Early cold morning in the empty dry fields on the outskirts of Settat, Morocco. FATHER and BROTHER walk fast through tall dry grass, searching anxiously, FATHER pointing ahead with a worried face, mist in the background.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Outskirts field near Settat, Morocco, grey sky. DET crouches examining the ground, two uniformed Moroccan police officers in navy uniforms stretch yellow police tape behind him, a white police car parked on a dirt road.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Simple Moroccan living room with blue zellige-pattern cushions. FATHER sits sadly holding an old small grey keypad mobile phone box in his hands, explaining, while DET stands taking notes in a small notebook.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A telecom company office with computers and filing cabinets. DET leans over a desk reading long printed call log sheets with lots of lines, a clerk in a blue shirt hands him more printouts.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan police station interrogation room with a bare bulb. DET slams his hand on the table facing a nervous suspect man in a black hoodie sitting on a chair, another officer watching by the door.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Police office at night with a cork board covered in photos and strings. DET rubs his forehead in frustration, coffee cups on the desk, a pile of files.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Police office desk lit by a desk lamp. DET holds up a small grey keypad mobile phone and looks at it intensely, determined, a paper with a long serial number on the desk.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Hospital corridor of the Hassan II hospital in Morocco, white tiles and green doors. DET walks quickly beside DOC who carries a clipboard, both serious, heading to the forensic lab door.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: A forensic laboratory with microscopes and test tube racks. DOC holds up a small sealed sample tube to the light with a shocked expression, DET leans in beside her, eyes wide.
